# San Diego based Origami Therapeutics is developing next-generation protein degraders and correctors for CNS conditions – the lead program is focused on Huntington’s disease


Jun 27, 2026


Founder & CEO Beth Hoffman describes how Origami’s platform is different than other degrades like PROTACs, and how it specifically is designed to clear the mutant huntingtin protein. Plus, details on a global collaboration announced earlier this year with Ipsen.


[Watch Interview](https://www.biotechtv.com/post/origami-therapeutics-june-26-2026)
